privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be exactly 'Weekly Time Allocation Diary - Student Life Study 2024'. The presentation mode must be 'Group-by-group'. There must be 3 groups: 'Daily Activities', 'Sleep and Self-Care', and 'Demographics'. The 'Daily Activities' question must be type 'Array (Numbers)' (internal code ':'). It must have 8 rows (Attending classes or lectures, Studying or doing homework, Paid employment or work, Volunteering or community service, Physical exercise or sports, Socializing and social events, Screen-based entertainment, Commuting or travel) and 7 columns (Monday-Sunday). Validation must be set to Min: 0, Max: 24. The survey must be in an 'Active' state at the end.
